modifications: Translate Godot's filter, downsample and eight-tap upsample stages to bgfx shader language.
Preserve the HDR max-channel threshold, smooth transition, bloom floor and luminance cap controls.
Use a bounded one-to-six-level RGBA16F pyramid owned by a project RAII runtime pass.
Composite additive glow RGB while retaining the source alpha contract; omit Godot engine, RID and OpenGL types.

Expose Godot Add, Screen, Soft Light, Replace and Mix in one glow/display pass: all modes except Soft Light run before tone mapping, while Soft Light tone maps source and glow separately before blending.
Share the pinned Godot tone functions between the standalone display shader and combined glow/display shader to prevent formula drift.
